recipe: Extend ComponentProps with an element string literal (e.g. ComponentProps<"div">) to create a props interface that includes all valid HTML/SVG props plus your custom ones.
trigger_condition: You are building a wrapper component around a native HTML or SVG element and need to add custom props on top of the built-in ones.

recipe: Use ComponentProps<typeof Component> to extract the full props type of an existing component without manually redefining it.
trigger_condition: You need to reference or reuse the props type of a component in your own type definitions.

recipe: Index into ComponentProps<typeof Component> with a prop name (e.g. ComponentProps<typeof Icon>["name"]) to extract the type of a single prop that a library does not export.
trigger_condition: A component library exposes a prop type that is not publicly documented and you need it in your own code.
